SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I have something to talk to you about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It seems that you have mustered up some enthusiasm... but it is still useless no matter how many times you say it.

TEXT: I don't know if it'll be useless or not. Come on, accompany me for a bit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Unfortunately, I don't have the time to talk to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You might not have stuff to talk about, but I have things I need to say to you.

TEXT: ...You're sure being forceful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Isn't it useless if I don't do that to the current you?

TEXT: So you're trying to twist my will with force?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE

TEXT: After all, I have had some experience before.

TEXT: ...I see. However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then please try to make some time...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Going for a low profile this time? Do you think bowing your head and begging will work?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's useless, your pride is worthless if you lower yourself just like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's true that my pride is worthless, reducing myself to this. I know fully well about my own worthlessness.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But please! Listen to what I have to say!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...No, I have nothing to say to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: In any case, don't interfere.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Interfere...? I'm just going to talk to you on the way home...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's certainly a waste of time being forced to stay here. Fine, I'll go to the clubroom instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Aren't you planning on going home?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...I just remembered I had something to do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then I'll accompany you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...You do know that this will be hindering my goal, yes?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm also a member of the club. There's no problem, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Certainly, you're indeed a member too. However, you do know paper members will only hinder other members of the club?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: T-There shouldn't be any problem if I kept quiet, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You'll just be an eyesore if you stayed there, senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-You don't have to say it like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So you just don't want to be with me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It seems that you perceived that quite well. That's exactly what I feel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Am I really such a hindrance to you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Absolutely. What do you want me to say this time to reject you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Anything will do, just say it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: All right, then I will.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You're a hindrance.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I'll say it as many times as necessary. To be entirely honest, you're being a pain.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Reflect on how your own actions can cause troubles for others.

TEXT: How many rejections will it take for that low IQ brain of yours to understand?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh!? Eh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...You're being quite harsh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That's because you've already done this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't get it! I'm just worried about you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why are you rejecting me?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Me! Not just me, Kirino too! Everyone too!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ......You won't understand even if I were to say it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You wouldn't know that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Quiet. Drive these words into your skull. Stop following me around.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't say such a thing... Won't people naturally be concerned about someone they know if they were to act strange all of a sudden?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ......Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yes, wouldn't you be concerned too if someone you know acted strange?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It depends on the person. I make a distinction between friends and mere acquaintances.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't think we're complete strangers, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You're a friend who hangs out with us, and even came to my house to play, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Even though that's true...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I'm getting more worried the more you put it this way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's useless to worry, just accept it if the person in question says so.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's why I said I'm getting more worried when you're acting like this!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: *sigh*... Do you know what "None of your business" is?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Is that how it is right now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes, exactly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: *sigh*... Senpai, don't you get it even though I've said this much?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, I don't get it. I don't know what to say to get you to understand.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Then let me tell you, I wish you would give up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Pestering isn't a form of expressing concern, do you get it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's what I'll do if I think it's required...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But, from what it seems, there's no choice but to pester you endlessly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's why...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ....I got it already, this is the last time, so let me accompany you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: The last time? What are you talking about? To begin with, nothing has happened yet...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Do you really get it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Nope, I don't get it at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Oh really, then I'll put it across clearer, since it's tedious.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: So it's better if you stop it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Tedious, you say... It's a setback even to me when you say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Then I'll say it a few more times, it's tedious.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then as a last struggle being the tedious person, I'll just pester you all the way.
I won't let you escape anymore...
